review_evidence: README and publication-status documents describe an active Lean formalization of Partial-MCSP, circuit complexity, magnification, lower-bound barriers, conditional endpoints, and explicit audit surfaces, while explicitly disclaiming an unconditional P != NP theorem.

The hydrated snapshot contains 377 Lean files and a unit-wide proposition scan found thousands of theorem/lemma/example/axiom declarations across pnp3, pnp4, fact libraries, tests, audit routes, and frontier modules.

Path roles such as tests, audit routes, failed/refuted routes, and historical compatibility material carry formal statements and provenance relevant to prior-art search, so no path-name-based exclusion is lossless here.
summary: Retain the complete P-vs-NP complexity-theory formalization and its audit/frontier material without hard exclusions.
